title: AiVanceResume
description: Structured resume document model encompassing document metadata, multiple tailored versions, standardized section types, work experience bullet points, measurable achievements, and chronological dates.

id.description: Unique identifier for the resume entity

userId.description: User identifier who owns this resume

title.description: Display name of the master resume document

primaryVersionId.description: ID of the designated active or default version

fileName.description: Original file name if imported from disk

fileUri.description: Storage URI of the original binary artifact (PDF/DOCX)

rawText.description: Plain text extraction of the resume contents

versions.description: Ordered history and role-tailored versions of this resume

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when resume was first created

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of most recent modification

targetJobId.description: Optional Job ID this version was tailored to match

targetRole.description: Target job title for this version

lastModified.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of version edit

content.description: Unstructured text or narrative markdown (used for SUMMARY or simple sections)

title.description: Job title, degree name, project title, or certification name

organization.description: Company, educational institution, or issuing authority

location.description: Geographic location of role or institution

startDate.description: Start date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD)

endDate.description: End date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD), or null if currently active

isCurrent.description: True if candidate is currently employed or enrolled here

description.description: General description or scope of responsibilities

achievements.description: Quantifiable outcomes and business impact metrics

skills.description: Skills and technologies demonstrated in this item

url.description: Link to project, publication, repository, or credential verification
